headline: MTN Extends IHS Holding Acquisition Deadline to December 17
summary: MTN Group extended its closing deadline to complete the proposed acquisition of tower infrastructure firm IHS Holding Limited by one month to December 17, as the telecom operator works to satisfy outstanding deal conditions.
why: MTN Group is Africa's largest mobile network operator by subscribers, and tower infrastructure partnerships are critical for managing its operating expenditure.

impacts.name: MTN Group
impacts.why: The transaction deadline extension provides additional time to fulfill regulatory and closing requirements.
